newsitem.title: JAPAN: Volvo to launch first 4WD model in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Volvo to launch first 4WD model in Japan.

text.p: Volvo Cars Japan Corp, the Japanese unit of AB Volvo, said on Thursday it will introduce its four-wheel-drive (4WD) version of the Volvo V70 AWD station wagon model in Japan later this week.
The car will go on sale on Friday with a retail price of 5.8 million yen, it said.
Volvo Cars Japan plans to import 3,300 V70 AWDs in 1997, but the import volume could be revised depending on demand for the model, a Volvo Cars Japan spokesman said.
Volvo Cars Japan said early this year it aimed to achieve Japanese sales of 25,000 cars in calendar 1997, up from 23,500 a year earlier.
